caption: The drawing depicts a small wooden cabinet with a dark brown finish. The cabinet has a curved top and an open front, revealing two interior shelves, each with several small vertical pegs evenly spaced along their length. There is a small blue item, possibly a closed book or a box, resting on the lower shelf. Below the interior shelves, there is a framed drawer with a single round knob at the center. The cabinet sits on a base with a stepped design. In the top left corner of the drawing, there is an outlined technical sketch of the cabinet with dimensions labeled as 14 inches tall and 8 1/2 inches wide. The cabinet and its features are carefully rendered with shading to indicate depth and texture. The drawing is set within a rectangular border, with the artist’s name and a reference number written in the bottom right corner. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Walnut Spool Cabinet
